title: Rater Equivalence: Evaluating Classifiers in Human Judgment Settings
reasoning: The paper introduces a framework specifically for "human judgment settings," which are often subjective and value-laden, such as content moderation for inappropriate comments or harassment. It directly addresses the challenge of evaluating classifiers when human judgments, influenced by cultural and ideological backgrounds, serve as the standard. This focus on evaluating performance on tasks requiring moral or ethical assessment makes it related to ethics evaluation.
